# Dnyx Draft
> Local-first Markdown editor with instant live preview, LaTeX math formulas, Mermaid diagrams, and client-side privacy.

## Overview
Dnyx Draft is a web-based Markdown application designed for developers, researchers, writers, and students. It operates 100% locally in the browser with IndexedDB persistence, requiring no account, login, or cloud database.

## Key Capabilities
- Real-time GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) preview
- LaTeX mathematics with KaTeX ($...$ and $$...$$)
- Flowcharts, sequence, and entity diagrams with Mermaid.js
- Local document organization with folders, tabs, and tags
- Client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted vault
- Export to formatted PDF, standalone HTML, and raw Markdown
- Ephemeral Share Snapshot links
